description: Utility functions for distributed training, tensor handling, and miscellaneous helpers in an object detection project, including classes for smoothing values, logging metrics, and managing distributed processes.

classes.name: SmoothedValue
classes.description: Tracks a series of numerical values and provides smoothed statistics such as median, average, global average, max, and current value, with support for synchronization across distributed processes.

classes.name: MetricLogger
classes.description: Logs and manages multiple SmoothedValue meters, supports updating metrics, printing logs, and synchronizing metrics across distributed processes.

classes.name: NestedTensor
classes.description: Encapsulates a tensor and an optional mask, with methods for device transfer, decomposition, and representation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the SmoothedValue with a new value.

methods.name: synchronize_between_processes
methods.description: Synchronizes the SmoothedValue metrics across distributed processes.

methods.name: median
methods.description: Returns the median of the stored values.

methods.name: avg
methods.description: Returns the mean of the stored values.

methods.name: global_avg
methods.description: Returns the global average computed across processes.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value in the stored values.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the most recent value.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the smoothed metrics.

methods.name: all_gather
methods.description: Gathers arbitrary picklable data from all processes.

methods.name: reduce_dict
methods.description: Reduces a dictionary of tensors across processes, optionally averaging.

methods.name: get_sha
methods.description: Retrieves current git commit hash, diff status, and branch name.

methods.name: collate_fn
methods.description: Collates a batch of data, converting the first element into a NestedTensor.

methods.name: nested_tensor_from_tensor_list
methods.description: Creates a NestedTensor from a list of tensors, supporting batched images.

methods.name: setup_for_distributed
methods.description: Overrides the print function to disable printing on non-master processes.

methods.name: is_dist_avail_and_initialized
methods.description: Checks if distributed training is available and initialized.

methods.name: get_world_size
methods.description: Returns the total number of processes in distributed training.

methods.name: get_rank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the current process.

methods.name: is_main_process
methods.description: Checks if the current process is the main process.

methods.name: save_on_master
methods.description: Saves a model or data only if in the main process.

methods.name: init_distributed_mode
methods.description: Initializes distributed training based on environment variables.

methods.name: accuracy
methods.description: Computes top-k accuracy metrics for model outputs.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Performs tensor interpolation with support for empty batches, compatible with different torchvision versions.
